analysis.title: GS Consumer: 3 Topical Stocks
key_insights: TJX is +8% pre-market after its print. Marmaxx comp came in at +2% against an expected +1% (small beat). Management said it expects further improvement at Marmaxx in the fourth quarter, while consensus models +2%, which implies guidance above the Street despite harder compares.

Feedback on TJX had turned more cautious in the two weeks before the print, centered on a slowdown at Marmaxx and Homegoods, although total shares shorted did not rise much. The pushback is a 30 bps gross margin miss, but the desk sees comps as the key KPI for the stock now.
TGT was the most debated of the early reporters. Bulls point to comps of +5.6% and +5% traffic in 3Q, which they call a traffic inflection among the best in the industry.

TGT bears argue the comp upside and November acceleration are driven by trading/Pokémon cards while apparel is soft. The 4Q implied EPS guide is below consensus, and TGT faces a hard 1Q-2Q lap from tax refunds.

TGT trades at about 17x ex-tariff-refund EPS, above its history, but the desk says that is not high relative to comp and growth versus peers. 1H27 is the test of whether the turnaround is sustainable.

NKE opened +7% on the 2031 targets from its analyst day and closed -6% near the lows, after investors questioned the targets. The guide is heavily back-half weighted, and the company already flagged revenue and margin declines in FY28, so the targets depend on FY29-31.

NKE trading flow: a few cover orders early, then the desk turned better for sale from both shorts and long sellers. Some covering came near $35 late in the day, and the day finished better for sale. The stock was -13% intraday.

Brooke Roach (GS equity analyst) sees elevated execution risk as NKE launches and scales new product, and thinks more patience is needed before a sustainable inflection. FY29-FY31 targets call for profit margins at the upper end of historical ranges.

Stock -13% intraday after the analyst day. The guide is back-half weighted with FY28 revenue and margin declines already flagged, and execution risk is elevated.

sector_views.rationale: Desk commentary is mixed: off-price and Target show traffic and comp strength, while the 1Q-2Q lap against tax refunds is a common concern across Retail.

earnings_insights: TJX 3Q (reported 11/18 pre-market): Marmaxx comp +2% versus expectation of +1%, a small beat. Gross margin missed by 30 bps. Management expects further Marmaxx improvement in 4Q, while consensus models +2%.
TGT 3Q (reported 11/18): comps +5.6%, traffic +5%. The 4Q implied EPS guide is below consensus. Valuation is about 17x ex-tariff-refund EPS.

NKE: management released 2031 targets at its analyst day on 11/17. The company already noted revenue and margin declines are likely in FY28. Profit margin targets for FY29-31 are at the upper end of historical ranges.

TJX: harder 4Q compares and a 30 bps gross margin miss.
NKE: back-half-weighted guide, FY28 revenue and margin declines, and elevated execution risk in new product launches.
vol_and_positioning: TJX: total shares shorted had not risen much despite more cautious investor feedback ahead of the print.
